recording_basis: Actual view_image calls in this agent turn. This contains subjective bounded visual observations; exhaustive pixel checks are separate.
selection_rule: Per condition first fixed user, plus the actual-final-Top1 path user with the lowest mean cosine across all six query pairs; the least-user rule was inherited and declared before new results. All raw figures remain preserved.
